examples.chinese: 一個人的想法會隨著身分、角色的不同而改變。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge rén de xiǎngfǎ huì suízhe shēnfèn, juésè de bùtóng ér gǎibiàn.
examples.english: A person's way of thinking will change along with differences in identity and role.

examples.chinese: 身分證是用來證明一個人的身分時使用的。
examples.pinyin: Shēnfènzhèng shì yòng lái zhèngmíng yī ge rén de shēnfèn shí shǐyòng de.
examples.english: An identity card is used when proving a person's identity.

examples.chinese: 去郵局領包裹的時候，記得帶身分證、圖章還有通知單。
examples.pinyin: Qù yóujú lǐng bāoguǒ de shíhou, jìde dài shēnfènzhèng, túzhāng hái yǒu tōngzhīdān.
examples.english: When going to the post office to pick up a parcel, remember to bring your ID card, seal, and notification slip.

items.wordHook: 奇(strange) + 怪(strange) → 'strange-strange': 奇怪 means odd.
Extending a gentle 扌(hand) to 包(wrap) your arms warmly around someone is to 抱(hold).
a 艹(grass) transforms with 化(change) into a 花(flower).
Combining 願(desire) and 望(expect): 願望 means wish, hope.
Fierce howling gusts of stormy 風(wind) batter the coastal observation 台(platform) as a storm hits: 颱(platform).
